title: Launch of Dong Fang Hong 1
summary: On 24 April 1970 China launched Dong Fang Hong 1, its first satellite, on a Long March 1 rocket from the Jiuquan missile base. The 173 kg satellite broadcast a patriotic song, and the launch made China the fifth nation to put a satellite into orbit on its own rocket.

uncertainty.note: Day given by all three sources; launch time given as 21:35 and 9:35 p.m.

where.modern_name: Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center, Gansu, China
where.historical_name: Jiuquan missile base (Base 22), People's Republic of China

importance.justification: China's first satellite launch, which made it the fifth nation to orbit a satellite on its own rocket.
